title: Reading Roll Quest [Phonics Game]
description: A phonics activity for grades 1–4. Follow these simple steps to use it with your class.
steps: Open the game and choose Board Style 1 (Connect 3) or Board Style 2 (Trophy Race).
In Custom Classroom Words, enter ONE word per line.
Press ✓ Update & Populate Grid to place your words on the board.
Choose Background Music and Master Volume if desired.
Close Settings, set ⏱️ Timer, and start the game.
Students take turns rolling/playing, reading words, and competing for points.

sections.heading: 💾 How to export, import, or load your game data
steps: Open ⚙️ Settings, enter one classroom word per line, then press ✓ Update & Populate Grid.
In Game Data Preservation File System, press 📤 Export Data to download the saved game data.
Keep the downloaded file in a safe folder.
Next time, open ⚙️ Settings and press 📥 Load Data.
Select your exported file, check the grid and words, and start playing.

tips: The instruction JSON file in the website guides folder is NOT the same as the game-data JSON file you export.
A browser may remember changes on one device, but do not rely on that as your only backup. Export after editing whenever the game offers it.
Button labels and available editing features can differ between games. If your game does not show an export/import button, that feature has not been confirmed for that game.
